# HingeConstraint2D

- Inherits [`Constraint2D`](constraint2d.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HingeConstraint2D")`

Joins two parts at a point that both can rotate about: a door, a wheel, a pendulum or a lever. With `Anchor0` and `Anchor1` at the same position in the world, the parts stay together there and rotate freely, unless limits or a motor are enabled.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `LowerAngle` and `UpperAngle` limit the rotation. |
| `LowerAngle` | `number` | `-90` | read/write | How far `Part1` can rotate clockwise, in degrees, from the relative angle the parts had when the joint was created. |
| `MotorEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the hinge drives itself toward `MotorSpeed`, for a wheel, a fan or a windmill. |
| `MotorMaxTorque` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The largest torque the motor can apply, in newton meters. A load that needs more stops the motor. |
| `MotorSpeed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The speed the motor drives toward, in degrees per second. Positive is counterclockwise. |
| `UpperAngle` | `number` | `90` | read/write | How far `Part1` can rotate counterclockwise, in degrees, from the relative angle the parts had when the joint was created. |
